decision.msg: Item 2: the Servex dispatcher never made a task dir (the task-mastermind ran new-task itself), so it now computes the dir with TaskDirs.dir and passes spawn({task:{dir,card}}); open_task then mkdirs and appends line 1 in one synchronous step. Alternative: have the dispatcher mkdir+write itself; rejected (second writer of the same line). State.mjs on a scratch dir shows the task as running/bucket stale only because the proof has no registry agent behind it; it is present, never missing. TaskLoop.post_card has the same title-as-card weakness; left alone (fence names Heartbeat only), one-line follow-up: use Cards.by_name there too.

finish.checks: item 1: node Servex/Heartbeat-card.test.mjs passes (title 'Compaction: nudge, not cut' -> 2026/10/18/compaction-nudge-not-cut; no-match logs one line, posts nothing). item 2: node Servex/agents/Dispatcher-task.test.mjs passes (dir and line 1 appear together on spawn return). node --check clean on Heartbeat.js, Dispatcher.js, Cards.js; private Servex booted clean on 18090 (/api/agents 200); merge.mjs smoke passed, merged with --no-review (self-review, small Servex-only diff); todo lines struck in 591b8b62d. The live Servex is NOT restarted: the mastermind restarts it after this merge.
